note: SCCE has no language model in any lane. Two things are declared here and nothing else is permitted: the visual embedder below, off unless its config gate is set; and the language-model REFERENCE SYSTEMS the sealed evaluation measures SCCE against, which are deliberately models and are the baseline, never the product. tools/no-hidden-model-check.mjs verifies that no file under packages/ imports a declared reference, so a declaration cannot be used to bring a model into the runtime.

packages.name: @huggingface/transformers
packages.purpose: Local ONNX runtime for visual evidence embeddings (Phase 3) only.
packages.network: Model files are fetched only by an explicit `scce model download`; inference never calls out.

models.purpose: Visual evidence embeddings (Phase 3): image/PDF-page vectors stored as attributes on evidence spans; text-side query embedding for the late-interaction prefilter.

evaluationReferences.purpose: Local language-model reference system for the sealed head-to-head. Runs as a separate process under the harness, answers the same sealed questions, and is scored against SCCE. Declared assistance: local-language-model.
Harness for the invented-entity benchmark: drives SCCE over HTTP and the same local reference model over its own endpoint, and scores both. Measurement only.
Harness for the code-repair comparison: gives SCCE and the same local reference model identical broken files and compiles both outputs. Measurement only.

Harness for the self-repair comparison: mutates real SCCE modules, gives SCCE and the same local reference model the identical defect, and scores both by the same compiler and byte comparison. Measurement only.

Harness for the acceptance-workload comparison: gives SCCE and the same local reference model an identical invented corpus and identical questions, one of which the corpus cannot answer, and scores grounding and fabrication from the corpus bytes. Measurement only.
